mapper.select: SELECT es.id AS stageId, es.title AS title, es.description AS description, es.order_number AS orderNumber, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stage_completions sc WHERE sc.stage_id = es.id AND sc.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN true ELSE false END AS isCompleted, em.id AS materialId, em.title AS materialTitle, em.video_url AS videoUrl, COALESCE(( SELECT vp.watched_position FROM video_progress vp WHERE vp.material_id = em.id AND vp.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS lastWatchedPosition FROM education_stages es LEFT JOIN education_materials em ON em.stage_id = es.id WHERE es.education_id = #{educationId} ORDER BY es.order_number ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS userName, d.name AS departmentName, e.title AS educationTitle, ep.progress_rate AS progressRate, CASE WHEN ep.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN true ELSE false END AS isCompleted, MAX(sc.completed_at) AS lastStudiedAt FROM education_progress ep JOIN users u ON u.id = ep.user_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id JOIN educations e ON e.id = ep.education_id LEFT JOIN education_stages es ON es.education_id = ep.education_id LEFT JOIN stage_completions sc ON sc.stage_id = es.id AND sc.user_id = ep.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, d.name, e.title, ep.progress_rate, ep.status, ep.id ORDER BY ep.id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_progress ep JOIN users u ON u.id = ep.user_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_progress ep WHERE ep.status != 'COMPLETED'
AND ep.education_id = #{educationId}
